Texts are written between quotes. Double quotes
mean the same. What decides the type is how many characters are inside:

blocks.description: At the top, A between single quotes and between double quotes both lead to the Character type. Below, empty quotes and a two-letter text lead to the String type.

caption.text: The number of characters between the quotes decides the type, not the kind of quotes.

runs.text: A character is a single Unicode code point, including those outside the basic plane such as a simple emoji. A grapheme made of several code points is a string. The text is kept as it is, without normalising. A text cannot span several lines: a line break is written with
